name: NGC 1015, host of SN 2009ig (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1015, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n1015-hubble
story: A barred spiral seen face-on, its smooth, tightly wound arms swirling out from a ring around a central bar of gas and stars. In 2009 a Type Ia supernova, SN 2009ig, flared here, the kind of exploding white dwarf astronomers use to measure distances across the Universe.
